entries.current_evidence: Typed aggregate expressions and filters execute through the lake bridge and row-plan aggregate contract.
entries.missing_evidence: Aggregate expression pushdown still needs a typed-plan capability bit, exact expression semantics proof, collation/null safety, and deterministic fallback to non-pushdown execution.
entries.evidence_symbol: relational rows aggregate contract accepts typed expression inputs and filters

entries.current_evidence: Shared routed-row materialization tests gate spill and hard-cap accounting for row materialization paths.

entries.evidence_symbol: routed rows materialization tracker uses shared spill and hard cap policy

entries.current_evidence: Representative aggregate, window, CTE, and typed read parity fixtures exist, but they are not domain-shaped workload fixtures.
entries.missing_evidence: Add SQL versus REST/SDK typed-plan execution fixtures for usage rollups, RBAC membership queries, wake-one queries, dashboards, and migration/backfill validation queries.
